· Barclays Capital Prime Services provides settlement and custody services in all of the following markets. Details of our Standard Settlement Instructions (SSIs) for cash and securities are contained in this document. · All accounts listed relate to Barclays Bank PLC. It is a separate legal entity operating under the Barclays Capital brand name.
Instruction Deadline
· Barclays cut-off time for securities transactions is 20:30 local time on Trade date for each market, as a best practice Barclays request that client inform their Client service representative of any trades instructed with a shortened settlement cycle ( e.g. same day transfers) from that applicable to the market in question. · Please note that trades received after cut off will be instructed for settlement on reasonable efforts basis.
Interest Charges and Market Penalties
· Fail costs, interest charges and market penalties may be incurred when trades are received late or are booked incorrectly.
24 Hour Global Client Service
· It is vital that you check with a client service representative before trading in markets not listed in this pack of SSIs.
